fn solve(n: Int, k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (k <= n)
  ensures (len(result) == 2)
  ensures (result[0] >= 0)
  ensures (result[1] >= 0)
  ensures (result[0] <= result[1])
  ensures (result[0] <= (n - k))
  ensures (result[1] <= (n - k))
  ensures (result[0] == (if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 0 else 1))
  ensures (result[1] == (if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 0 else if ((n - k) < (k * 2)) then (n - k) else (k * 2)))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == [])
